# Parse the note content to extract songs
content = _mem['s10']['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:  # skip header
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('- '):
        continue
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = line.split(' BY ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    rest = parts[1]
    # rest contains artists and release
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    artist_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
    release = release_part.strip()
    songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
print(songs)
